goal: Produce a local-CSV-only Markdown report of the (grade × region) cross-tab of row counts and mean reading_score from offline_data/students.csv, highlight the highest- and lowest-mean cells with sample sizes, annotate every key number with its source, and save the report to disk with its absolute path returned.

plan.title: Load CSV & compute cross-tab: Read offline_data/students.csv; group by (grade, region) for grade in {G10,G11,G12} and region in {A,B,C,D}; for each cell compute row count and mean(reading_score); identify the cell with the highest mean and the cell with the lowest mean (tie-break by larger sample size, then lexicographic); save the full cross-tab (including the two highlighted rows) to offline_data/grade_region_cross.csv. Every number must carry its source annotation (source: offline_data/students.csv, column reading_score, aggregation = mean over N rows).

Write Markdown report: Using the cross-tab CSV from step 1, write a Markdown report to offline_data/grade_region_report.md containing: (a) a level-1 title, (b) a data table of all 12 (grade, region) cells with row count and mean reading_score, (c) explicit callouts of the highest-mean and lowest-mean combinations with their sample sizes, (d) every key number annotated in-place as '（来源：offline_data/students.csv 的 reading_score，mean over N 行）' or '（来源：由前述两行计算）' for derived ratios, (e) a concluding paragraph at the end. Save the file to disk and return its absolute path. No web access.
